details:
This is just as the title says; an option within the settings to turn off the profile and nameplate cosmetics for you, locally. There are a number of reasons for why I am requesting this. 

First of all, the new profile and nameplate cosmetics have introduced stutters and lag spikes when clicking onto someone's profile. This is not only a problem for performance as a whole -even just having your small menu open, with friends to the side, introduces more lag now- but also a problem for moderation within groups as well. The lag spikes and stutters introduced by these cosmetics means it takes more time to do moderation actions, which in turn can allow the people who are being moderated to have more time to do harm within the instance.

Second, the constant animation and presence of these cosmetics on one's profile and nameplates makes the legibility of them worse. I do not know about anyone else, but from what I've seen so far, these cosmetic animations never pause when you hover over them- they just keep on continuously playing. Not only does the constant animations impact performance, but they also make you strain your eyes every time you try to read someone's nameplate and or profile- which I'm sure no one would like to have to deal with.

At the very least, an option within the settings to pause the animations of these cosmetics would be much appreciated -though I personally would still prefer an option to turn them all off for myself- and would no doubt be a sizeable benefit for performance in general. Nonetheless, for those that have read this, thank you for taking the time to read my request, and farewell.
title: Option to turn off profile and nameplate cosmetics locally
